title: Website Maintenance Agreement
text: Northstar Studio provides website maintenance to Maple Works for twelve months. The monthly fee is 500 fictional credits. Either party may terminate with 30 days of written notice.

title: Office Equipment Supply Agreement
text: Cedar Supply delivers ten desks to Harbor Labs within 14 days. The total price is 3000 fictional credits. Payment is due within 10 days of delivery.

title: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
text: Maple Works and Harbor Labs protect confidential project information for two years. Disclosure to third parties requires prior written consent. Public information is excluded.
